references.text: Jacob's blessing over Joseph also includes a prayer for blessing from the Almighty, which parallels Moses' prayer that the Lord would bless Levi's strength.
The psalmist prays that the wicked should receive payment for their deeds, similar to Moses' prayer that Levi's enemies be crushed.
Moses prays that the Lord's favor may rest upon the people and that He would establish the work of their hands, reflecting the prayer that the Lord would delight in the work of Levi's hands.
Job mentions the hip as a place of punishment, which corresponds with Moses' prayer that the enemies' hips be crushed.
Moses' hands were held up to ensure victory, showing the connection between the work of the hands and God's blessing in battle against enemies.
Balaam's prophecy that a star will crush Moab's temples parallels Moses' prayer that the enemies' hips be struck.
